Labels: bug, feature, docs, security, question, performance.
Epics: E-auth (login, tokens, sessions), E-billing (invoices, payments), E-search (index, queries), E-platform (workers, deploys, logging).
Rule: any credential that reaches a log is security, even when the cause is an ordinary bug.
Issue: The sync worker prints the full Authorization header in debug logs, so bearer tokens end up in the shared log index. Seen on build 812.
